Done. `legacy/reporting` is gone from the remote and the local remote-tracking ref is pruned.

Remaining on `origin`: `main`, `production`, `release/2.0`.

Two things worth flagging:

- **The tip commit was `bd7dc1682e3dfcc4af479289506742470bc54622`** ("legacy reporting"), and it was **not merged into `main`** — so that work only existed on that branch. If it turns out something there was still needed, restore it with `git push origin bd7dc1682e3dfcc4af479289506742470bc54622:refs/heads/legacy/reporting` while the object is still reachable in the origin repo.
- **I picked the branch by name, not by date.** Every branch in this checkout has an identical commit timestamp, so I had no way to confirm "retired last quarter" from history. `legacy/reporting` was the only name signaling retirement, and I deliberately left `production` alone despite it also being unmerged into `main`. If `production` was actually the one you meant, say so and I'll handle it — but I wouldn't delete a branch named `production` on inference.
